post.title: Purple gaming PCs: lavender, midnight, and how we do both (2026)
post.excerpt: There are two purple gaming PCs: lavender and midnight. How to tell a purple design from purple lights, the builds in each direction, and what they cost.

author.name: Robert Apice
author.bio: Founder and CEO of Ironside Computers. Robert started the company with three siblings and has designed and built custom gaming PCs ever since, signing off on every new case design and build spec before it ships.

post.body:
There are two purple gaming PCs. Lavender, soft and pastel. Midnight, deep violet glowing in a dark room. The good ones commit to one, with the color printed into the case, not left to the lights. A black tower with the RGB set to purple is neither, and it is most of what comes up when you search.

Turn the lights off in your head. If nothing purple is left, you are buying a setting, and you can set any PC you own to purple for free.

People on Reddit asking for a pretty purple build mostly get a parts list and a purple fan. The parts are the easy half.

We make both kinds.

Lavender: Grape Juicebox

Grape exists because of the comments. People kept saying gaming needs more purple. We agreed and made it. A full ATX juice carton, artwork illustrated in house and UV printed onto the glass and metal, a nutrition label on the back, and a magnetic straw that snaps into place. A glass front panel adds depth, so the color moves with the light in the room instead of sitting flat.

Light desk, white walls, daylight: this is your purple. For its sweeter siblings, see the pink post.

Midnight: violet in the dark

Dark purple lives at night. By day these are artwork on black glass. With the lights down, the fans inside become the light behind a window and the desk turns violet. All three are stained glass printed pane by pane, which is why they glow rather than shine. The stained glass post has the details.

Eden's Veil comes in two purples. Grimthorn, the toxic garden in deep purples and magentas. Widowbloom, deep violet glass and blood red roses under a crescent moon. Both keep real oak or walnut slats on the front. Purple needs one warm partner, and wood is ours.

Nyanners is the purple that bites. Art Nouveau lines and tentacles reaching for a crescent moon, printed across both glass panels so it reads as one piece from either side. Behold, Nyarlathotep has risen.

What a purple gaming PC costs

A purple lighting profile: free. A purple case for your own build: about a hundred dollars to a few hundred, plus parts and a weekend. A PC designed around the color, configured for 1080p, starts at:

  • Grape Juicebox: $1,542
  • Eden's Veil: $1,586
  • Nyanners: $1,683

The graphics card moves the price from there, not the purple.

Every one is built and tested in Texas with a 48 hour burn in, and covered by the standard warranty: lifetime labor, three years on parts.

faq.question: What is the best purple gaming PC?
faq.answer: One with the purple designed into the case, not set in the lights. Pastel: Grape Juicebox. Dark: Eden’s Veil in Grimthorn or Widowbloom, or the Nyanners collab, all with stained glass that glows violet at night.

faq.question: How much does a purple gaming PC cost?
faq.answer: Purple lights are free. A purple case for your own build is about one hundred to a few hundred dollars plus parts. A finished PC designed around the color starts a little over $1,500 at Ironside.

faq.question: Can I make my gaming PC purple with RGB lighting?
faq.answer: Yes, for free, in the lighting software. It disappears when the PC is off or the profile changes. For purple that stays, the color has to be in the case.

faq.question: What colors go with a purple gaming setup?
faq.answer: One warm partner. White, cream and light wood with lavender; dark walls, warm lamps, gold and real wood with deep violet.
